name: Solitaire
description: Klondike solitaire for a touch screen. Tap a card to pick it up (with every card on it), then tap the column or foundation it goes to; tap a card twice to send it home, to its foundation if it can go there, else to a column that takes it. Tap the stock to draw one or three cards (a setting), and again when it is empty to turn the waste over. Undo goes back as far as you like, and Finish puts everything away once all cards are turned up. On a wide screen the columns get the whole height; on a tall or square one it is the classic table. Forward draws and back undoes on frames with buttons. Win and the cards cascade off the foundations as they did in Windows solitaire, falling, bouncing along the bottom and leaving trails of copies behind them; a tap stops them, the next deals again. On e-paper the win is one picture of the cascade. On black-and-white panels it plays in high contrast, hearts and diamonds drawn as outlines; the Contrast setting picks it anywhere.
